name: Sheraton Grand Danang Beach Resort & Spa
positioning: Beach resort on Non Nuoc Beach in Danang with a private beach, an ocean-view infinity pool, plunge-pool rooms, Shine Spa and a Kids Club with a mini water park
best_for: Couples who want a plunge-pool room, an ocean-view infinity pool and spa treatments
Families who want a Kids Club, a mini water park and suites with kitchenettes

facts.text: The resort has a private beach.
The resort has 17.3 acres of landscaped gardens.
Accommodations have private balconies with views of the pool or the Danang coastline.
Suites have a living room, a dining area and a kitchenette.
Suite bathrooms have marble accents, full vanities and luxury bathrobes.
The resort offers seafront yoga sessions.
The Kids Club offers supervised crafts, a gaming lounge and a mini water park.
The mini water park has slides, tube rides, a spray tunnel and water-soaking buckets.
The resort is near Hoi An Ancient Town and the Marble Mountains.
La Plage serves fresh seafood in a beachfront setting.
The resort is near Legend Danang Golf Resort, whose 36-hole course was designed by Greg Norman and Jack Nicklaus.

highlights.text: The resort is on Non Nuoc Beach, overlooking the ocean.
The infinity pool has a view of the ocean.
Deluxe Plunge Pool rooms have a pool view and a plunge pool.
Beach activities near Non Nuoc Bay include Hobie wave sailing, sunrise stand-up paddleboarding and kayaking.
Shine Spa offers personalized treatments inspired by local traditions and modern therapies.

considerations.text: The resort hosts events from large-scale corporate conferences to gala dinners.
The minimum age to check in is 18.
WhataHotel notes the resort is outside Da Nang city center, so exploring the city requires transportation.
